# examples/date/selectorContainer throws on load and renders nothing

**Claim it first:** comment on this issue before you start, and check the open pull requests for one that already points here. We merge the first approve-worthy PR (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`, point 3). This row comes from #19920, where @bercedev has first pick on its rows.

## Context

Welcome! This is one row of #19920, split out so that its fix closes its own ticket. You need a fork, Node and the dev server (`npm run server-start`); no Agent OS, Docker or AI tooling.

A headless sweep of every example page on 2026-10-20 found `examples/date/selectorContainer` throwing during construction and rendering nothing. It still does on `dev` `f5decee2c0`. Open `http://localhost:8080/examples/date/selectorContainer/index.html` and the console shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'format')`. The page fails the same way at `13.2.0`, so this predates 13.3.

## The Problem

The stack runs from `src/date/DayViewComponent.mjs:109` (`me.intlFormatDay.format(date)`), up through `createContent`, to `construct` (`:70`), which calls `this.createContent(true)`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `intlFormatDay` arrives through `bind` (`:38`) from a state provider, and its default is `null` (`:51`).
- A bound config is set after construction, so code inside `construct` still sees `null`.

## The Fix

The likely cause, which the fix confirms or corrects: `construct` builds the day cells before the bound formatter exists. Let the content wait for the formatter, or build it without the formatted text while the formatter is `null` and fill the text in when it arrives.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `examples/date/selectorContainer` loads with no page error and renders its date selectors.
- [ ] AC-2: a unit test in `test/playwright/unit/` fails before the fix and passes after it.

## Out of Scope

- The other rows of #19920, which have their own tickets. `examples/calendar/weekview` fails in a similar way and has its own ticket.
